messages.subject: Unfulfilled paid order
messages.text:
I’m contacting you regarding an order I placed and paid for on September 18 via PayPal. The order has never shipped, and I have not received any tracking information or communication since payment. 
 
 

 Please advise on the status of my order. If the items are unavailable or have not yet shipped, I request a full refund to my original PayPal payment method. 
 I’ve attached a copy of the PayPal transaction for your records. I would appreciate confirmation of either shipment or refund within 7 business days.
 
 

 

 Thank you for your attention to this matter.

messages.subject: Re: Unfulfilled paid order
messages.text:
Hi Kelly,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!

messages.subject: Re: Fwd: Unfulfilled paid order
messages.text:
Hi Kelly,

You're right, and I'm sorry. Waiting this long with nothing but the same automated reply twice is not acceptable, and it's not how we do things here.

I'm taking care of your refund personally. I'll process the full amount back to your original PayPal payment today, and you'll get a confirmation once it's done. Depending on PayPal, it can take a few business days to show up in your account.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
